t: This is Green Park tube station, on the edge of Green Park with entrances on both sides of Piccadilly. Three lines call here: the Jubilee, the Piccadilly and the Victoria. It's in fare zone one. Two architects are linked to it. Leslie Green is known for the oxblood red tiled stations he designed across central London in the early twentieth century. Elsie Owusu, a Ghana-born British architect and the first chair of the Society of Black Architects, also worked on the station.
